graph.title: Digital Potentiometer Control (AD5206) with SPI
notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1. AD5206 is still a new part type because lookup_part did not find it.

Breadboard placement is my own, because the Fritzing image is not visible as text. The chip straddles the centre gap: pin n is at column 3+n in the top bank (row e) and pin 25-n is in the same column in the bottom bank (row f). Only the top (tp/tn) rails are used for 5V and GND.
Connections follow the sketch comments: CS to pin 10, SDI to pin 11, CLK to pin 13. All A pins and VDD go to +5V. All B pins, GND and VSS go to ground (VSS = 0 V is within the specified range).
Channel i's wiper Wi feeds a 220 ohm resistor, then LED i anode. The LED cathode goes to the ground rail through a jumper. Each resistor is placed in the same breadboard strip as its W pin.
Wire ends on the Arduino are joined to header sockets. Wire ends in the breadboard have both a joined edge and an electrical edge.
The Arduino is assumed to be powered over USB, which is not in the parts list, so no cable is added.
